specs.cpu: Intel Core Ultra 7 255H (Arrow Lake-H, 16-core, up to 5.1 GHz)
specs.gpu: Intel Arc 140T integrated (RTX 5050/5060 options on higher trims)
specs.display_type: IPS non-touch (2.5K 120Hz and 4K OLED touch on higher trims)

battery.notes: 69.5Wh. CNET flagged 'Unimpressive battery life' — real-world ~7-9h mixed; the main clearance trade-off.

price.notes: Dell.ca has discontinued the DA14250 (page redirects; XPS FAQ confirms 'Dell Premium name will be retired'). Remaining CA stock at Best Buy/retail clearance. CNET tested US$1,450-2,050 range; CAD estimate ~$1,700 clearance vs ~$2,600 original. VERIFY before relying on this entry.

offers.name: Dell Pro 14 Copilot+ PC Premium Laptop - Intel Core Ultra 7 266V - 16GB LPDDR5X - 512GB SSD - Windows 11 Pro - Magnesium

reviews.quote: one of the hardiest and heaviest 14-inch laptops I've ever encountered

praises: Quad-speaker array and haptic touchpad are genuinely class-leading — features the 2026 XPS 14 dropped
Arrow Lake-H 16-core with Arc 140T iGPU outperforms same-price 2026 ultrabooks in sustained multicore
8MP IR camera with excellent Windows Hello face sign-in (the 2026 XPS line has no fingerprint/strong IR story)
Clearance pricing makes premium CNC-aluminum build accessible under $2,000
dGPU trims (RTX 5050/5060) exist in clearance stock for creator work
complaints: 'Unimpressive battery life' (CNET) — a full 3-4h behind the 2026 XPS 14 it was replaced by
Superseded platform: no longer sold or restocked by Dell CA, so warranty stock depth varies by retailer
Soldered RAM; 16GB base trim limits the value at full original price
Throttles under sustained load — CNET noted the chassis can't hold full boost

design_philosophy: The 'Dell Premium' rebrand generation (2025) that lasted one year before Dell restored the XPS name: maximalist spec-sheet (dGPU options, quad speakers, haptic pad) over weight and efficiency. As clearance stock it is today's value door into Dell's premium clamshell family, per Dell's own XPS FAQ pointing Premium buyers to remaining stock.
rating_notes: Direct CNET anchor (Dell 14 Premium 2025, 7.2/10, US$1,450-2,050; NOTES-verified quotes). Base FHD+ trim assumed; webcam_speakers 8.0 for CNET-praised quad speakers + 8MP IR cam; battery 6.0 per CNET 'Unimpressive battery life'; portability 6.5 per 'Shockingly heavy' ~1.72 kg. Price estimated — clearance stock, dell.ca discontinued.
